description:
``POST /v1/tool-kits/{id}/instantiate``: add a kit to one agent (or preview it).

``credential_id`` is a tool-secret key holding the variant's ``requires.secret_names``
(binding it needs ``admin`` and ``providers:write``); without it the HTTP tools are stored
without their key headers. A ``composio_action`` variant needs ``connection_id`` (a
connected app) and, like picking app actions, ``admin`` and ``providers:write``. A
``dataset`` variant needs ``dataset_id``; ``key_columns`` defaults to the table's key columns.

actions.description: composio_action: the action slugs to pick instead of the kit's
actions.title: Actions

add_test_case.description: Add the kit's test case (its tools answer from fakes)
add_test_case.title: Add Test Case

block_prefix.description: Names what the kit adds (default: the kit's)
block_prefix.title: Block Prefix

dry_run.description: Only say what would be added; change nothing
dry_run.title: Dry Run

flow_anchor.description: Add the kit's flow steps after this step
flow_anchor.title: Flow Anchor

variant.description: A variant id (default: the kit's default)
variant.title: Variant

title: ToolKitInstantiate
